metadata.name: Sushi Belt Sumo
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: Disc Arena in a neon sushi bar the size of a stadium. Eight plates, each carrying a giant nigiri, ride a 60 m conveyor belt round the chef's island over the void: board them at the corners or off the bar counters, bank discs off the sushi, grab a power disc from the chef, take the sake bottle towers, and knock everyone else off the belt.

do.text: Irasshaimase! Ride the plates, knock them into the void.
